enable.title: Eternl Hub
enable.caption: Enable secure device pairing and multi-device signing

notSupported.title: WebSocket Not Supported
notSupported.caption: This device does not support WebSocket connections required for Eternl Hub. Please use a different browser or device.

connection.error: Not connected to Eternl Hub. Please enable Eternl Hub first.

instancePairing.title: Instance Pairing
instancePairing.description: Pair this Eternl instance with another device to sync wallets and sign transactions remotely

offer.description: Create a pairing code to connect another Eternl instance. Once paired, you can sync wallets and request remote signing.
offer.enterCode: Enter this code on the other device:

request.description: Enter the pairing code from another Eternl instance to connect and sync wallets.
request.pinHint: Enter the 6-digit code shown on the other device
request.invalidQrCode: Invalid QR code. Please scan a valid Eternl Hub pairing code.

instances.title: Paired Instances
instances.description: Manage paired Eternl instances for wallet sync and remote signing
instances.noInstances: No paired instances. Create a pairing code above or join an existing pairing to connect devices.
instances.noWalletsToImport: All wallets from this instance already exist locally
instances.instanceOffline: Instance is offline. Please ensure the other device is connected to Eternl Hub.
instances.pingNotAvailable: Ping service not available. Please reconnect to Eternl Hub.

confirmRemove.title: Remove Instance
confirmRemove.message: Are you sure you want to remove "{{deviceName}}"? You will need to pair again to sync wallets or request signatures.

confirmClearAll.title: Remove All Instances
confirmClearAll.message: Are you sure you want to remove all paired instances? All devices will need to be paired again.

pairing.title: Device Pairing
pairing.description: Pair this device with another device for secure multi-device signing

create.title: Create Pairing Code
create.description: Generate a pairing code to connect another device
create.share: Share this code with the other device

join.title: Join Pairing
join.description: Enter the pairing code from another device
join.pinHint: Enter the 6-digit code shown on the other device
join.encryptionNotice: End-to-end encryption will be established automatically

status.accepted: Pairing accepted! Devices are now connected.

warning.title: Verify Transaction Details
warning.message: Please carefully review all transaction details before signing. Ensure the outputs, amounts, and addresses are correct.

devices.title: Paired Devices
devices.description: Manage devices that can request transaction signatures
devices.noDevices: No paired devices. Pair a device using the pairing code above, or connect automatically by sharing the same wallet.

confirmRemove.title: Remove Device
confirmRemove.message: Are you sure you want to remove "{{deviceName}}"? This device will no longer be able to request signatures.

confirmClearAll.title: Remove All Devices
confirmClearAll.message: Are you sure you want to remove all paired devices? All devices will need to be paired again.

errors.offerExpired: Pairing offer expired. Please try again.
